provenance.scope: National 5 and Higher: the fixed six-part literacy question. Advanced Higher: written notation tasks and questions explicitly referring to a printed score, including aural annotation. Standalone aural concept questions and excerpt-version choice questions are excluded. Each paper counts once per type; separately marked parts count separately in task totals.
